atm.definition: When strike price equals current market price

delta.definition: Measures option price change for ₹1 move in underlying

expiry.definition: Date when the option contract expires

iv.definition: Expected volatility implied by option prices

lotSize.definition: Minimum quantity for trading an option

premium.definition: Price paid to buy an option

strike.definition: Price at which option can be exercised

theta.definition: Daily time decay of option premium

vega.definition: Option price change per 1% IV change
